name: goth-rotating-credential-epochs-across-cf0b
instr:
Goth cannot safely rotate provider credentials during authentication. Add credential sources that return immutable copied values with nonempty opaque epochs. Pin each epoch from initiation through callback completion, resolving it only when credential-dependent work begins.

Resolution failures return `CredentialError` with provider, operation, and cause, without redirects, requests, or stored bindings. Gothic must atomically store the epoch with its provider session and restore it before authorization or credential-dependent profile retrieval. Reject missing, mismatched, replaced-provider, and cross-provider bindings before token or profile requests without changing stored state. Provider replacement, failed callbacks, completion, and logout must preserve session disposition, remove only matching epoch data, and never cross-bind or orphan epochs. Preserve legacy constructors, names, defaults, registry identity, URLs, and authentication results.

GitHub adds `NewWithCredentialSource(clientKey, source, callbackURL, scopes...)` and `NewCustomisedURLWithCredentialSource(clientKey, source, callbackURL, authURL, tokenURL, profileURL, emailURL, scopes...)`. Discord, Google, GitLab, Slack, and Facebook add `NewWithCredentialSource(clientKey, source, callbackURL, scopes...)`; Okta adds `NewWithCredentialSource(clientID, source, orgURL, callbackURL, scopes...)`; Apple adds `NewWithCredentialSource(clientID, source, redirectURL, httpClient, scopes...)`. Preserve package defaults and au
